basics.name: Jim Leirvik
basics.label: Developer
basics.summary:
Fullstack developer with 10+ years of experience building and evolving business-critical systems across backend and frontend. I specialize in designing robust services, improving system quality through testing and architecture, and driving initiatives from idea to production.

Led platform initiatives, improved cross-team testing, and shipped internal tools that streamline operations. I focus on technical choices that shape real workflows—especially in regulated or complex domains.

Designed and implemented an internal tool that streamlined support workflows, reducing manual work and improving response time.
Collaborated across disciplines on solutions aligned with critical workflows and daily operations.
Used Azure DevOps for CI/CD, work tracking, and pipelines on a healthcare application.
